technical_checks.description: The target frame count, video-token layout, audio-token layout, and absolute origin match the checked plan.
The generated interval uses exact half-open token-aligned boundaries.
Known native state outside the denoise interval remains unchanged before decode.
Consumed denoise-mask metadata is cleared before persistence.
The run receipt resolves both the decoded artifact and retained native checkpoint.

visual_checks.description: No objectionable discontinuity, freeze, ghosting, or duplicated gesture at the left boundary.
No objectionable discontinuity, freeze, ghosting, or duplicated gesture at the right boundary.
The generated interval forms a coherent temporal passage between its known contexts.
Decoded content outside the requested interval remains acceptably stable.

technical_checks.description: The overlap and suffix use one globally aligned H3 AV timeline.
Only the explicit new suffix is appended to cumulative state.
The cumulative native result is content-addressed and retained.
The receipt binds source state, graph, runtime, prompt id, decoded artifact, and checkpoint.

visual_checks.description: Motion crosses the old/new boundary without a visible stall, reversal, duplicated beat, or jump.
Appearance drift remains acceptable for the requested continuation.
The new suffix adds usable temporal material rather than merely repeating the overlap.

technical_checks.description: The mask is either one static image or exactly one continuous mask per selected decoded frame, as declared by the variant.
Spatial resizing and temporal amax projection produce the checked H3 visual-token mask and preserve structural audio.
Native state outside the selected spatiotemporal generation volume remains unchanged before decode.
Consumed denoise-mask metadata is cleared before the edited native checkpoint is retained.
The receipt binds source state, exact mask hash, prompt, graph, output video, and retained native state.

visual_checks.description: Visible change remains concentrated in the requested spatial or spatiotemporal region.
No unacceptable seam, halo, ghost, frozen edge, or temporal pop surrounds the edited volume.
The regenerated region responds usefully to the requested prompt while remaining coherent with preserved context.

technical_checks.description: Every source range is bound to an exact content hash.
The output frame count equals the sum of all declared half-open source ranges.
Output frames preserve the declared source and intra-source order.
The assembled artifact is resolved from the exact run history.

visual_checks.description: The decoded artifact contains the intended ranges in the intended order without accidental omissions.

technical_checks.description: The source is a validated packed H3 AV state, not only a decoded video.
Source tokens map monotonically to the checked legal target lattice and missing tokens carry the declared native denoise mask.
The accepted output contains exactly `(N - 1) * factor + 1` frames and is delivered at `24 * factor` fps after cropping only H3 tail padding.
The sampled H3 target window remains inside the declared 124-362-frame trained range.
The receipt resolves source native state, target lattice, prompt, graph, generated native state, and decoded artifact.

visual_checks.description: The additional samples contain coherent newly generated motion rather than duplicate-frame cadence.
Appearance and geometry remain acceptably stable near preserved source-token anchors.
Velocity and acceleration do not show objectionable pulses, reversals, stalls, or ghost trails.
Revealed and hidden regions remain coherent across generated token intervals.

technical_checks.description: Reference images and clips enter conditioning in the exact declared order.
Every reference clip uses an accepted 24 fps H3-valid length.
The graph selects the locked Ref2VA model and both required VAEs.
The receipt binds ordered input hashes and the saved output artifact.

visual_checks.description: The requested visible or temporal properties of the supplied references are present in the result.
The result is temporally coherent rather than a sequence of unstable reference reconstructions.
No unacceptable tiling, tearing, frozen region, or decode artifact is present.

technical_checks.description: Only the endpoint inputs declared by the selected variant are connected.
Resolution and target length match the checked H3 plan.
The graph selects the locked FL2VA model, text encoder, and video VAE.
The receipt binds exact parameters, runtime manifest, prompt id, and saved video artifact.

visual_checks.description: Supplied endpoints are reconstructed with acceptable fidelity at their declared temporal positions.
Motion between constrained and unconstrained frames is coherent.
A controlled prompt comparison demonstrates non-identical conditioning behavior at fixed seed.
No unacceptable tiling, tearing, frozen region, or decode artifact is present.

technical_checks.description: Every guide resolves to an exact valid target-frame position and accepted clip length.
All guides are chained on the active positive-conditioning edge.
Guide and target geometry follow the checked H3 lattice rules.
Ordered guide hashes, graph, parameters, and output artifact are retained.

visual_checks.description: The result reaches the supplied guide at the requested temporal position.
Motion approaching and leaving each guide remains coherent.
No unacceptable freeze, duplication, hard snap, or reconstruction scar surrounds a guide.

technical_checks.description: Source and target canvases plus offsets use exact 32-pixel alignment and the source fits entirely in the target.
The source visual latent is copied without interpolation and structural audio is retained byte-for-byte.
Only newly allocated visual regions carry generation strength in the baseline.
Consumed denoise-mask metadata is cleared before persistence.
The receipt resolves the source checkpoint, expanded native result, and decoded artifact.

visual_checks.description: The original picture remains acceptably stable inside its exact source rectangle.
Newly generated regions continue structures, light, texture, and motion without unacceptable border seams.
The expanded composition is usable at the requested centered or directional placement.

technical_checks.description: Every comparison holds source, prompt, seed, sampler, scheduler, steps, and shifts fixed while changing only denoise strength.
The original native AV state, not a decoded/re-encoded substitute, is the sampler initial state.
Structural-audio generation strength remains zero for every ladder member.
Consumed denoise-mask metadata is cleared before persistence.
Each ladder result resolves its exact strength, graph, prompt id, video artifact, and retained native state.

visual_checks.description: The pass produces a useful visible improvement rather than an effectively identical copy.
Temporal motion remains coherent without ghost delay, drag, stutter, or changed gesture timing.
Appearance and composition drift remain acceptable at the chosen strength.
For the masked variant, visible changes remain concentrated in the requested region.

technical_checks.description: The cut lies on synchronized visual and structural-audio boundaries.
Re-appending the untouched suffix reconstructs the source native state exactly.
Prefix and reversible suffix are independently content-addressed.

visual_checks.description: The reconstructed state's decoded result is visually identical to the source within the chosen deterministic comparison.

technical_checks.description: The second pass uses the same locked H3 checkpoint and H3 VAE without an auxiliary learned upscaler.
Frame count and 24 fps clock are exactly unchanged.
Target width and height match the declared 32-pixel-aligned geometry.
Structural-audio denoise remains zero throughout spatial regeneration.
The receipt resolves source native state, initial-state method, denoise, graph, output video, and retained native state.

visual_checks.description: The H3 pass creates useful definition beyond a deterministic resize control.
New texture does not shimmer, boil, crawl, or change discontinuously across frames.
Important forms, composition, appearance, and gesture timing remain acceptable.
The tiled variant contains no unacceptable overlap seam; this check is not applicable to full-frame variants.
